import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source1_19_0 and Source1_19_1 on 'calaccess_committee_id'
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=("_x", "_y"),
)

# Convert and ensure correct types for each target column

# ocd_prop_id: string
joined["ocd_prop_id"] = joined["ocd_prop_id"].astype(str)

# calaccess_prop_id: integer
joined["calaccess_prop_id"] = pd.to_numeric(joined["calaccess_prop_id"], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# ccdc_prop_id: integer
joined["ccdc_prop_id"] = pd.to_numeric(joined["ccdc_prop_id"], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# prop_name: string
joined["prop_name"] = joined["prop_name"].astype(str)

# ccdc_committee_id: integer

# calaccess_committee_id: integer
joined["calaccess_committee_id"] = pd.to_numeric(joined["calaccess_committee_id"], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# committee_name_x: string (from source0 committee_name)
joined["committee_name_x"] = joined["committee_name_x"].astype(str)

# committee_position: string (from source0 committee_position)
joined["committee_position"] = joined["committee_position"].astype(str)

# committee_name_y: string (from source1 committee_name)
joined["committee_name_y"] = joined["committee_name_y"].astype(str)

# calaccess_filing_id: integer
joined["calaccess_filing_id"] = pd.to_numeric(joined["calaccess_filing_id"], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# date_received: string
joined["date_received"] = joined["date_received"].astype(str)

# contributor_lastname: string

    "calaccess_committee_id",
    "committee_name_x",

    "committee_name_y",
    "calaccess_filing_id",
    "date_received",
    "contributor_lastname",
    "contributor_firstname",
    "contributor_city",
    "contributor_state",
    "contributor_zip",
    "contributor_employer",
    "contributor_occupation",
    "contributor_is_self_employed",
    "amount",
]

target_df = joined[target_columns]

target_df.to_csv(
